    except Exception as e:
        return None, "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)

def record(label, result):
    status, body = result
    m = FLAG_RE.search(body or "")
    if m:
        found.append(m.group(0))
    observations.append("=== %s [%s] ===\n%s" % (label, status, (body or "")[:3000]))
